reviews.review: pretty much the same formula as the previous games. There are a whole lot of lame go here and scan that quests though. Seems they censored some dialogue. The plot isnt as engaging/dramatic as ME1 but then neither was ME2 or 3 compared to 1.

Surprisingly this is a good game!
...which makes it even more annoying, because this could have been a great game. 
IMO, the foundation is pretty solid: the movement and combat are pretty great, the story and characters range from OK to pretty good and I even like a lot of the quests, even though some of them are not that imaginative in their design. Also, I found the new galaxy and the lore very interesting.

Why is it not a great game?
1. Glitches. It's mostly animations and mostly when you are in dialogue - which makes it pretty visible. I got used to it but it felt unfinished.
2. Missing content. There are multiple instances where the ending of a quest or story lines feels rushed. It again feels unfinished.

I still recommend this game as I had a lot of fun. 

After recent developments, however, I don't know, if I would feel comfortable giving money to the new owners of EA.

Still a blemish on the series eight years later.

I thought, optimistically, that surely the state  this game launched in would have improved by now? No. Same stilted animations, horrific looking NPCs, terrible voice acting and monotonous open-world bloat that is ill-fitting for a game in the Mass Effect universe.

I am so starved of new Mass Effect content due to BioWare being inept that I hoped I could derive some joy from this...abortion of a game, but I can't. 

The characters are so grotesque. Why do Krogans now sound like Brazilian Male Prostitutes? Why are Turians trying to thirst-trap me?  Why does the character creator have 20 shades of brown and only one white? It's dire when your character creator is so ugly and restrictive I played with Scott Default over any kind of player expression.

Everyone touts "muh gameplay" as an improvement but ME3 sweeps this out of the water; melee feels weak, jumping is stiff like Starfield jet packs and enemies on NORMAL are spongier than even Harbinger was on ME2 insanity.

I genuinely cannot comprehend a single thing to like about this game, it's so bad it feels like it's a parody of the series done as some avant-garde high art satire written by Tommy Wiseau. 

Mass Effect is dead, and this killed it. It's a shame I can't warp the Andromeda Initiative back to the Milky Way so Sovereign, Harbinger and the Catalyst can melt them down into Reaper goo - at least then they would contribute something of note to this franchise. 

T r a s h.
Not quite the original,but an excellent game in its own right.
